senses.gloss: עַכֵּיב ch. same, to detain, prevent, delay; to hesitate; to withhold.
units: Targ. Y. Gen. XXII, 12 (ed. Vien. עֲכִיבְ׳ Pe.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 22:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>דנכס לא מְעַכֵּב</he> he who is to slaughter tarries not.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 5:7">Targ. I Kings V, 7</cite> (h. text <cite ref="P00164"><he>עדר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 4:25">Targ. Y. Ex. IV, 25</cite> <he>ע׳ עלוי</he> prevented him.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 19:13">Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 13</cite> <he>למְעַכְּבָא</he> to retain; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 12b:4">B. Bath. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>עַכְּבֵיה גביה</he> he detained it (the couple) with him.
<cite ref="Berakhot 2a:13">Ber. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>כפרה לא מְעַכְּבָא</he> the offering of the sacrifice is no hinderance (to being permitted to eat T’rumah); a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 40:26">Targ. Is. XL, 26</cite> (h. text <cite ref="P00163"><he>נעדר</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 4a:4">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>שדר … ולִיעַכֵּב שתא וכ׳</he> send a messenger (to Rome), and he will be going one year, and be detained one year &c.
